original_metadata.title: Successive quantum-content fusion formula for every tableau primitive idempotent of semisimple complex H(m,1,N) with nonzero q and cyclotomic parameters
original_metadata.author: Oleg V. Ogievetsky; Loic Poulain d Andecy
original_metadata.source_title: Fusion Procedure for Cyclotomic Hecke Algebras
original_metadata.difficulty_reason: The proof constructs an ordered multivariable rational product whose successive content evaluations give primitive idempotents. Its main obligation is to control apparent poles through Jucys-Murphy resolvents and to prove the multipartition generalized-hook normalization ratio, including new cross-component hook contributions rather than merely invoking a seminormal basis.

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: Complete Theorem1, resolvent identity Proposition2, removable-pole Proposition3 and multipartition Lemmas4-5 read. The exact assumptions are m>=1,N=n+1>=1,q!=0, all geometric sums1+q^2+...+q^(2r) nonzero for r<=n, q^(2i)v_j!=v_k for j!=k and -n<=i<=n, and all v_j nonzero. Evaluation is sequential u1=c1 through uN=cN, not simultaneous substitution. The scalar type-A hook-ratio lemma and semisimple Jucys-Murphy spectral idempotents are explicitly established published background. No group-limit/type-A specialization or one-tableau example is counted.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Full Section4 Theorem1 for the stated semisimple complex cyclotomic Hecke algebra H(m,1,N),N=n+1, with q and all v_j nonzero and restrictions(2)-(4). Each standard m-tableau T has E_T=F_lambda Phi evaluated successively at its quantum contents; source supplies F_lambda and the precise product order. No arbitrary root-of-unity/non-semisimple parameter or simultaneous evaluation asserted.
